answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a reef against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to validate network transactions. An attacker must accumulate substantial timber of staked assets, rendering identity proliferation prohibitively expensive. This resource scarcity creates a glacier of resistance, as the cost to acquire sufficient stake to subvert consensus grows linearly with the attacker's intent to capture the network, effectively neutralizing the incentive to create low-cost autonomous agents.
